thread:
alex: quick heads-up — canary backfill job 202950 removed default-role binding from a handful of service accounts in prod (edge-proxy and event-ingestor). I saw 401s on health checks. Starting investigation.

maria: which migration exactly? role_backfill_v3?

alex: yes role-backfill-v3, ran as canary at 1829501200. We only intended to set default_role where tenant_id IS NULL, but the predicate matched principal_type='service_account' incorrectly and ended up clearing roles for some entries.

jon: deploy-bot shows migration finished: run_id=202950, exit=0

deploy-bot: Migration role-backfill-v3 started by alex at 1829501200. run_id=202950. Finished: exit 0.

sre-oncall: paused the next canary batch and scaled edge-proxy to 0 replicas to stop traffic impact. Also toggled the alert to awareness-only.

alex: proposed mitigation steps:
1) mark run_id=202950 as failed in migrations table (prevent auto-retry)
2) reassign default_role for affected service accounts via targeted SQL
3) run audit query to find any other affected principals
4) add unit/integration tests for principal_type handling in backfill code
5) coordinate with kms team to verify keys weren't impacted

maria: SQL to reassign (run on leader during short maintenance window):
```
BEGIN;
UPDATE rbac.principals
SET roles = array_append(COALESCE(roles, ARRAY[]::text[]), 'service_default')
WHERE id IN ('svc-edge-proxy', 'svc-event-ingestor')
  AND NOT (roles @> ARRAY['service_default']);
COMMIT;
```

jon: running audit query to find principals with empty roles and principal_type='service_account' now.

jon: audit results: 5 principals in prod matched. Pushed list to #sec-ops-private and shared SIDs with infra.

alex: @kms-bot can you confirm whether any KMS key ACLs were modified or if any decrypts started failing for those svcs? We need to rule out key access issues.

kms-bot: KMS audit: no ACL changes detected. Last successful key usage by svc-event-ingestor at 1829501100. No decrypt errors reported.

maria: running smoke tests after SQL patch: token fetch, signing ops, and a short e2e trace. Will report back in ~10m.

alex: temp mitigation: rotate service tokens for affected svcs and set short-lived tokens where possible. @sre-oncall coordinate token rotation and LB health-check restores.

sre-oncall: acknowledged. Rotating tokens for svc-edge-proxy and svc-event-ingestor now. Will restart pods with new tokens and update health checks when green :thumbsup:.

alex: creating a hotfix PR to add a defensive canary-flag and stricter predicate checks in the backfill code. Also adding a migration-run guard to require dry-run approval before mutating prod.

jon: +1. I'll start a terse postmortem in docs/incident-182950.md with timeline and action items.

maria: smoke tests reported: edge-proxy and event-ingestor green. No 401s seen for 5m. Closing current pager alerts.

alex: good. follow-ups: schedule a full run in staging with negative tests, add unit tests for principal_type matching, and review migration tooling for safety checks.

sre-oncall: monitoring for 30m then will clear the incident channel. Closing thread.
